rules.text: Do not flag small, simple oval shapes or tiny central specks as anomalies; these are valid normal variants.
rules.justification: The agent incorrectly flagged items with extreme size reduction or simple oval geometry as anomalies, failing to recognize these as valid normal variations in the dataset.

rules.text: Do not flag internal dark voids, holes, or bright streaks as anomalies; these are common normal features.
rules.justification: The agent consistently misclassified normal internal structures (voids, holes, streaks) as defects, indicating a failure to distinguish between pathology and normal anatomical variation.

rules.text: Do not flag irregular, multi-lobed shapes or detached fragments as anomalies; these are valid normal morphologies.
rules.justification: The agent flagged complex shapes and fragments as defects, but the ground truth confirms these irregular morphologies are part of the normal class distribution.
